'''FC Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk''' ({{langx|ru|ФК «Нефтехимик» Нижнекамск}}) is an [[association football]] club from [[Nizhnekamsk]], Russia, founded in 1991. It played at the second-highest level in the [[Russian First League]] in 1993–1998, 2001–2004, 2012 to 2013–14, 2016–17 and from 2019–to present.  Neftekhimik has won 5 Second Division titles.

It has been a farm club of [[FC Rubin Kazan]] since 2007."}}
